mainEntity.name: What types of interior finish upgrades are common for residential projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common interior finish upgrades include enhancing flooring, cabinetry, countertops, paint, trim, and lighting fixtures. For homeowners in the East Bay, popular choices often involve durable, low-maintenance materials that complement diverse architectural styles found in Berkeley or Oakland homes, such as hardwood or engineered wood flooring. Considering your home's existing aesthetic and your functional needs will help determine the most suitable upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common interior finish upgrades involve flooring, cabinetry, countertops, paint, trim, and lighting. Popular choices in areas like the East Bay often favor durable, low-maintenance materials.
